description: Transcribes an audio file at a public https URL on EdgeCloud and returns the text. Charges credits per audio minute, only on success; price it with quote. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

audio_url.description: Public https link to the audio file

max_price_credits.description: The most you'll pay for this call, in Wave credits. Needed unless you pass quote_id; the call fails if the price is higher

minutes.description: Audio length in whole minutes for pricing, 1-30

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by quote (valid 5 minutes, single use). Use instead of max_price_credits

name: audio_transcribe
title: Transcribe audio
